--  Notes:- Removed Lower from natco_code as there is no value in caps
--  Internalemployee filter is always no only in whole dataset so removeng additional filters

WITH
  base AS (
    SELECT
      event_date as date
	  ,action
	  ,session_id
	  ,log_time as curr_time
	  ,page_name  as curr_page
	  ,LEAD (log_time, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY log_time) AS next_time,
    LEAD (page_name, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY log_time) AS next_page
    FROM 
      silver_layer.t_link_journey_checkout_com
    WHERE page_name like '%checkout%'
	     AND LOWER(action) = 'pageview'
	 and {{date}}
      AND (
        'All' IN ({{servie_line}})
        OR lower(service_line) = lower({{servie_line}})
        OR lower(ui_page_category) = lower({{servie_line}})
      )
      --   AND lower(internalemployee) = 'no'
      AND natco_code = 'de'
      AND (
        'All' IN ({{os_naame}})
        OR lower(user_device_type) = lower({{os_naame}})
      )
      AND lower(category) <> 'addonmanagement'
			  		AND (
'All' IN ({{category}})
OR category = {{category}}
OR LOWER(category) = {{category}}
)
  )


,base2 as
 (
SELECT
  session_id,
  curr_page,
  next_page,
  from_unixtime (curr_time / 1000) as t1,
  from_unixtime (next_time / 1000) as t2,
  date_diff ('minute', from_unixtime (curr_time / 1000), from_unixtime (next_time / 1000)) AS diff_time
FROM
  base
WHERE lower(next_page) is not null 
	and lower(curr_page) like'%payment%'
	and curr_page <> next_page
)
,base3 as
(
SELECT session_id, sum(diff_time) as time_spend
FROM
	base2
where 
diff_time <= 8
group by 1
order by 2 DESC
)
 
SELECT round(avg(time_spend),1) as avg_time_spend
from base3
